title: Stakelogic Unveils Sunken City Riches With 15,000x Win
excerpt: Stakelogic launches Sunken City Riches, which includes persistent reel modifiers, a mystery pick bonus, free spins and a maximum multiplier of 15,000x.
content:
Stakelogic has launched Sunken City Riches, an online slot featuring persistent reel modifiers and a bonus round with a maximum multiplier of 15,000x. Announced in Malta on October 26, 2026, the game uses a 1,024-ways format and lets players unlock additional features by collecting Treasure Map Scatter symbols.

Set among submerged ruins of an ancient civilisation, the latest game in Stakelogic’s slot portfolio combines overgrown stonework with clockwork machinery. Its progression system allows unlocked features to carry over between spins.

Treasure Map Scatters Unlock Reel Features

Treasure Map Scatter symbols can land anywhere on the grid and contribute to two meters. Every four scatters unlock another reel modifier. These features remain available on subsequent spins, activate randomly and can trigger together.

Payway Maker copies a random symbol from the first reel across the remaining reels to create a winning way. Symbols Upgrade promotes a randomly selected paying symbol to the highest value on the paytable.

Add Wild Multipliers introduces between one and three multiplier wilds, while Split Symbols divides up to 10 symbols of different types.

Wilds appear on reels two through five, substitute for all paying symbols and can split and multiply.

Gem Meter Leads to Mystery Pick Bonus

The second meter collects multiplier values attached to scatters instead of paying them immediately. Once players gather 20 gems, the Mystery Pick Bonus opens.

Gem colours indicate their values. Green gems carry multipliers from 1x to 10x, followed by higher values represented by blue and red gems. Purple gems are worth between 500x and 1,000x.

During the bonus, players select gears until they reveal the Collect Gear. The resulting multiplier is applied to the stake.

The Gem Meter operates alongside the permanent feature unlocks, giving players two progression systems during regular gameplay.

Free Spins Include Guaranteed Features

Three or more Free Spins Scatter symbols trigger the Free Spins Feature. Retriggers award three, four or five additional spins, and every reel modifier remains available during the round. At least one feature activates on each free spin.

Players can activate Super Stake™ for 50% of the base bet, doubling their chances of triggering free spins. Alternatively, they can purchase the bonus for 100 times their stake.

James Jelliffe, Head of Slots at Stakelogic, described the game's progression system.

“Sunken City Riches is built around progress that sticks. Instead of handing players one feature and then resetting, the Treasure Map Meter keeps adding to what the reels are capable of, so the game a player is looking at after some spins is not the same game they started with.”

Jelliffe also highlighted the relationship between the meters and the bonus round.

“Pairing that with the Gem Meter gives players two things to chase at once, and because the multipliers are visibly banked before they are paid, the Mystery Pick Bonus arrives with real weight behind it. It is one of our most feature-dense releases to date and we think players will enjoy piecing it together.”

Source:

“Stakelogic surfaces a lost world in new release Sunken City Riches”, Press Release, October 26, 2026
